amendments.what: Per-resource acquisition evidence in the shared session runner. amendments.what: SessionRunner gained verify_watchdog_owns_pod, and collect_and_teardown's blocked branch now tears the pod down when it cannot establish a live owner instead of asserting that the watchdog is a backstop. attempt14 left an L40S billing for about 116 minutes with nobody to stop it: the artifact collector exited 5, the teardown gate refused to delete the pod holding the only copy of a required artifact, and the launcher returned. amendments.why_the_owner_is_shared_session_runner: The defect is in SessionRunner.collect_and_teardown and SessionRunner's watchdog launch, the only place a watchdog pid exists and the only place the blocked-collection branch is taken. Every phase that acquires a provider resource runs this code -- Phase A, Phase B, the continuations, C1, C2 and the preflight -- so all of them shared the defect and all of them receive the repair. It cannot be fixed from a caller: no caller can see the watchdog pid, and the blocked branch returns before any caller regains control.
